comment: Pack art (issue #57), written by `packbuilder build` and `packbuilder art-review`; review on the contact sheets in build/pack-art/<pack id>/. Per species: the source photo ids, the workflow, isolation and prompts versions and the set's edition theme it was painted with, the seeds, the painting's SHA-256 (the art cache's file name), its fidelity, and the review: pending, approved (in the pack), rejected (repainted with new seeds by the next build) or gap (no art; why).
